label: Hunting Horn
note: MH4U's general-purpose endgame HH is Maqam Sedition (1456 display / 280 true raw, +20% affinity, 2 slots, 10 units of natural purple), which rolls to sharpen and therefore pairs with Razor Sharp. The common damage set is Razor Sharp + Attack Up XL + Weakness Exploit + Horn Maestro, with Evasion +1, HG Earplugs, or Challenger +2 as flex. The model captures Attack Up XL (+25 true raw) and Maqam's encored Attack & Defense Boost (S) song (1.15x); Razor Sharp, Weakness Exploit, Horn Maestro, HG Earplugs, Challenger +2's conditional +25 true raw/+20% affinity, and the Seregios roll-sharpen are unmodeled. Akantor Dark Melody is the higher-raw Sharpness +1 alternative, but needs Honed Blade and lacks natural purple.
